tasks.title: Init and day-2 commands share lock, safe-write, spawn and readiness helpers
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, Reuse (extract before the second use), shared files and Tool facts; Decisions 3, 4, 7-9 and 13; Security impact and Rollout order. FIRST extract the owned .pulse-init.lock and atomicWrite/link/mode checks from cli/write-install.ts into tested cli/lock.ts and cli/safe-write.ts; migrate init before adding consumers. Preserve lock nonce/ownership and recorded signals, change refusal to 'another pulse command is running in <dir> (or remove .pulse-init.lock if none is)', and fsync both file and containing directory. safe-write.ts owns the single validate-on-read/write-state-before-side-effect helper shared by rotation-journal and upgrade.json, durable rename and archive finalization. Put open/write/fsync/rename/unlink behind ONE injected file seam with named failure and hard-kill boundaries, so T4 can distinguish staging temp write, staging rename, staged journal write, install rename and saved journal write; test these primitives here, keep the rotation state machine and its matrix in T4. Extend cli/docker.ts's only spawn seam for input, stdinFd and stdoutFd, preserving ignored stdin by default, bounded calls and Docker exit 3; distinguish missing binaries by name so missing gh can exit 1. Extend cli/ready.ts's parsePs with full ID and readyz/waitReady with container-id targeting rather than adding a poller. Implement constant API_SCRIPT (stdin JSON, fixed localhost URL, 10 s timeout, redirect error, 1 MiB response cap), status parsing and timingSafeEqual file comparison in cli/api-call.ts. Export/reuse own() from cli/docker.ts and assertPin/PULSE_IMAGE from cli/services.ts; services.ts and its tests are declared because Reuse explicitly requires them. Extend cli/test/fake-docker.ts as the only fake spawn, recording input, fds, signals, full container ids/states and a named stop-at-step hook for the rotation and upgrade matrices. Every shared module states what it owns and tests its variants; no duplicate guards, pin patterns, spawns, file seams, state writers or readiness loops.

acceptance.expected: 0 failing tests; .pulse-init.lock refuses a second owner and never removes a changed owner's lock; init preserves valid tokens/keys and records interrupts; writes use wx, final mode, file fsync, rename and directory fsync, refusing links and unsafe modes. The one injected file seam can stop at open/write/fsync/rename/unlink boundaries with an ordinary error or a hard kill without cleanup; atomic rename preserves the old or new complete file. Absent input keeps stdin ignored, input closes stdin, fd streams preserve literal bytes, and full 64-hex ps IDs select the intended container. API transport uses stdin only with 10 s/1 MiB/redirect:error; equality prints only same or different. Docker ENOENT remains exit 3 and missing gh is distinguished by name. tasks.title: pulse token rotate safely hands over local tokens and resumes interrupted rotations
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, rotation-journal, token-rotate, command wiring, api-call consumer checks and docs; Decisions 1 and 3-9; Required behavior (token rotate and Help and docs); Counterexamples (Selection, Order, Handoff resume, Lost answer, Stage boundary, Revoke guard, Journal resume, 409, Legacy api, Files, No secret in argv); Acceptance evidence 1 (production behavior), 3 (rotation AND stage-boundary matrices), 5-6; Security impact and Rollout order. Extend cli/lock.ts, cli/safe-write.ts's shared state reader/writer and injected file seam, cli/api-call.ts, resolveProject/guarded, readyz/waitReady/parsePs, tokenContentValid, shown(), firstLine/maskUserInfo and cli/test/fake-docker.ts. Keep the complete rotation state machine and its recovery matrices together. Preflight every location/candidate/file and exactly-one ready consumer before any POST; record full oldContainerId. Implement requested/replacing/staged/saved/refreshing/refreshed/handoff/switched/revoking/done with durable states, validation, activeTokenId/revokeTokenId/replacementName and old/new container IDs. Stage each received rotate/create secret through a wx 0600 temp, fsync, rename to secrets/.pulse-next.<file>.<tokenId>, directory fsync; journal staged with activeTokenId BEFORE renaming over the host file, fsync the directory, then journal saved. Every resume FIRST executes Decision 8's complete reconcile table before reading a host bearer or making an API write: remove only recognized safe-write temps, recover requested/replacing with matching staging files, confirm replacement identity/name with the specified staged/admin bearer, distinguish staged-with-file from staged-without-file, and refuse inconsistent staging. States never move back from staged. Only replacing AFTER reconcile found no staging file can sweep exact-name orphans. Before EVERY revoke, check /admin/tokens/self and refuse either the authenticating id or activeTokenId, keeping the journal. Lost rotate answers compare rotatedAt before retry; persist replacementName/revokeTokenId before create, recover lost create answers, stage/save/switch replacement then revoke only the lost id. Use ONE fake API helper mapping secrets to ids and enforcing real revoked-secret 401, permitted self-revocation and last-admin 409; extend the sole fake spawn. Probe handoff follows the observed-container resume table without rescaling old+new; new readiness, 10 s bounded same-token check and 2000 ms precede old stop/removal. Cover missing/stopped/duplicate/new-only containers and repeated different. Admin identity precedes console recreate/readiness/equality/own-file identity. Only necessary consumers change, locations run serially, and output reports inspect-derived W or unknown when old is gone. Record signals through API/staging/install/state critical sections and exit 130 at the next boundary. Parse selectors, journal-argument matching and timeout 1-3600 default 120; handle 401/403/404/409/429 and malformed replies safely. Wire HELP/COMMANDS/dispatch/errors. Add command and Token recovery docs including staging files (secret-bearing, never delete manually during a journal), reconcile/revoke refusals, overlap expiry, no-running recovery, standalone exclusions and manual equivalents. Replace manual rotation bullets and update pinned-release text; explain measured W and extra-load formula/short-interval limits from Performance impact. All unit fault matrices belong here; real overlap/continuity/resume checks belong to T6.
